title: Stockroom: complete, trusted, self-maintaining library
note: Source of truth for the rebuild. scripts/progress.py renders this to the terminal, to REBUILD-PLAN.md and to the live HTML page. Edit the JSON, never the generated files.
owner_requirements: Import everything from that list, its proper data from mouser, digikey, lcsc if possible using api keys. Import everything so we can change the way the data's manipulated later (human naming scheme for example).
Every non passive has trusted files downloaded and shown in the UI; non passives just show in the UI and only exist for bom creation later down the line.
All non passive components linked properly to the edas.
Everything done within the app, not some third party manipulation u do.
App updates should be automatic and never face errors, app shouldnt have to fully relaunch to update either.

waves.name: Schema Gate
waves.why: The spec calls this 'the gate; everything below waits on it'. Nothing else may start until this is green and committed.

items.name: Part Record Model
items.why: Sourced/derived split, four part classes, per-asset origin and checks. Every downstream task builds against this contract.

steps.t: part_id: slug + sha256[:4], collision-proof
steps.evidence: Verified inline: MAX6817EUT+T and MAX6817EUT-T slug identically (max6817eut-t) but yield distinct ids (-e331 / -9c69). Negative control shown.

steps.t: Windows reserved stems guarded
steps.evidence: CON/PRN/AUX/NUL/COM1/LPT9 all rewritten to part-<stem>-<hash>; is_reserved_stem returns True for each.

steps.t: part_class: passive/component/mechanical/virtual + override
steps.evidence: model/part_class.py: PartClass enum, ClassNeeds, RequirementOverride, needed_kinds().

steps.t: sourced/: append-only raw payloads beside the record
derived block, disposable and recomputable
assets carry origin + checks (evidence, not verdict)
steps.evidence: model/asset.py: AssetRef/AssetOrigin/Asset/EdaAssets. model/trust.py derives Verdict from checks on read.

steps.t: Migrate call sites across ingest/mutation/store/api
steps.evidence: Two call sites passed the removed kwarg: ingest/passive_add.py:308 and mutation/library_ops.py:393 used eda= where the field is now assets=. Fixed; that alone cleared 162 of 108 failures' occurrences.

steps.t: Update stale test expectations (eg sourced/ is a legitimate 6th profile subdir)
steps.evidence: 24 test files updated: eda->assets, +[ref] unwrap, specs/category/description now under derived, passive flag -> part_class, and 40 hardcoded pre-hash ids replaced with make_part_id() so they assert the contract.

steps.t: Full backend gate green
steps.evidence: FULL suite green: 3424 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed (2m25s). ruff: All checks passed. Mutation-tested: breaking the id mint site turns test_library_ops RED (22 failed), so the rewritten assertions are not tautological.

steps.t: Committed on main

waves.name: Core (3 parallel)
waves.why: Everything here reads the part record and nothing else, so all three run concurrently. This is the critical path.

items.name: Derive Engine
items.why: The owner's acceptance test lives here: change the naming scheme, re-derive, lose nothing.

steps.t: Recompute the whole derived block from sourced/
IDEMPOTENT: derive twice, byte-identical records
LOSSLESS: a derive never writes under sourced/
Naming scheme swappable by config, not by editing code
Normalization moved from import time to derive time
Merged to main, gate green

items.name: Requirements By Part Class
items.why: Fixes 136 requirements nothing could ever satisfy: passives were being asked for Altium symbol and footprint.

steps.t: requirements = f(part_class, tool) off the EDA registry
passive resolves to [] for EVERY tool
mechanical = footprint only, virtual = nothing and no BOM line
requires_override wins over the class default
Requirement enum still matches the TypeScript union
Merged to main, gate green

items.name: Index Schema
items.why: Today the index physically cannot express 'has an Altium footprint'. It is single-tool, single-asset, and rebuilt from scratch every sync.

steps.t: Per-tool columns by iterating the EDA registry
Multiple purchase rows, not one purchase_url
Incremental sync, no DROP TABLE
Measured before/after on a synthetic 10k library
Expresses TRUST, not just presence
Search, facets and parametric filters still green
Merged to main, gate green

waves.name: Build (2 parallel)
waves.why: Both read the derive engine, so they wait for wave 1 to land.

items.name: Importer
items.why: The library is being deleted and rebuilt, so this is the tool that does it. No migration needed.

steps.t: Takes the MPN register, pulls Mouser + DigiKey
Writes sourced/<id>/<vendor>.json verbatim
Calls the existing derive engine, does not write a second one
Classifies each part into one of the four classes
Rate-limited part is DEFERRED, not FAILED
Stoppable and resumable, worklist derived from library state
Merged to main, gate green

items.name: Guided Capture UI
items.why: The surface the owner uses for a 90-part sitting. Every extra click is multiplied by 90.

steps.t: All four vendors on enrich/cad_sources.py
Catch, classify and attach the downloaded file
Record origin {vendor, url, captured_at} on the asset
Both formats per part where the vendor offers them
Fast path to the next part
Designed deliberately, screenshot critiqued both themes
Merged to main, gates green incl. frontend-dist

waves.name: Prove It
waves.why: Nothing ships to the real library until these pass. A failed acceptance test reported honestly beats a green claim.

items.name: Acceptance Test
items.why: The owner's own bar, verbatim: 'we can edit it without reimporting'.

steps.t: Import real parts into a scratch library
Derive twice, prove byte-identical
Prove sourced/ untouched by either derive
Change the naming scheme, re-derive, identity survives

items.name: Adversarial Review
items.why: This project has shipped a check that could not fail and an audit that was 100% false positives. Refute, do not confirm.

steps.t: Every new detector fed a known-BAD input
No presence-measuring code that reads like trust
No 'if tool ==' branch in shared logic
No success message emitted before the thing was observed
Nothing lost in the merges

items.name: Delete And Re-Import The Library
items.why: Step 2 of the owner's build order. Only after the schema is proven.

steps.t: Full backup of the current library taken and verified
Re-import all 158 records onto the new schema
Zero records missing description, manufacturer or datasheet
Owner confirms the app shows what they expect

waves.name: Still Owed
waves.why: Real owner requirements, deliberately sequenced after the schema. Listed so none of them goes quiet.

items.name: Device Parity
items.why: Owner: 'i meant libraries linked between devices'. Same parts, same files, same info, nobody clicking Sync.

steps.t: Two devices adding different parts converges
steps.evidence: Commit 7ed6b99 on branch wf/device-sync (not yet merged).

steps.t: Per-device enrich cache stops dirtying the synced repo
steps.evidence: Commit d8b9508 on branch wf/device-sync (not yet merged).

steps.t: Automatic PULL, not just auto_push
Merged to main, gate green
Verified on two real machines

items.name: Hot Reload And Auto Update
items.why: Owner requirement 5: 'app shouldnt have to fully relaunch to update either'. The first attempt produced zero commits.

steps.t: Frontend bundle reloads in place
Backend change restarts without a closed window
A failed update rolls back and says so
Every device converges by itself, no deploy script by hand

items.name: Automatic EDA Linking
items.why: Owner requirement 3. The spec's ordering: files first, linking second.

steps.t: KiCad symbol/footprint/3D linked by reference
Altium .SchLib/.PcbLib written with embedded 3D body
Linking runs automatically, not on a button

items.name: 3D Rotation Fix
items.why: Measured: 21 of 57 parts render wrong. Spec puts this LAST, labelled cosmetic. First attempt produced zero commits.

steps.t: Sign settled FROM EVIDENCE against KiCad's own viewer
rotate + offset + scale all applied
The 10 parts at 270 deg render correctly
No previously-correct part rotated away from correct
